news.headline: Central Florida Fri Nov 27 morning: NWS Melbourne River Flood Warning remains in effect for Melbourne — 7 AM fair 56°F, wind S 7 mph, humidity 93%; today mostly cloudy, high 69°F / low 56°F, wind W 11 mph gusting 18 mph, rain chance 0%; Sat high 68°F / low 58°F, rain 10%

Florida construction Nov 27 — The Club in Gulf Breeze will be razed for a 216-unit apartment complex at 1230 Crane Cove Blvd, built by Sunchase Companies under Florida's Live Local Act on commercially zoned land; the county gave preliminary approval for the development order Nov 25, with demolition and groundbreaking expected early next year

Florida housing — October single-family closed sales fell 10.1% year over year to 19,049, while the statewide median sale price rose 2.2% to $420,000, the eighth consecutive month of year-over-year gains; condo-townhouse median fell 3.3% to $290,000, with 4.6 months of single-family supply

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper bounced Thu Nov 26 — benchmark LME copper rose 1.9% to $11,867 per metric tonne as AI equities recovered, after falling about 17% over the past four weeks from September's record $14,875 per tonne; zinc jumped 3.5% to $3,511 a tonne on a smelter shutdown

HVAC — ACHR News: heat pumps rose from about 28% of new homes in 2022 to nearly 48% in partial-year 2026 in an Ekotrope/HERS dataset of more than 2.1 million rated homes, and AHRI put heat pumps at 44.7% of combined cooling equipment shipments in August 2026, up from 31% in August 2016

Markets Fri Nov 27 — U.S. stock futures surged as investors returned from Thanksgiving: at 2:13 AM ET Dow E-minis were up 446 points (0.89%), S&P 500 E-minis up 1.65% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis up 2.47% (Reuters); NYSE closes early today at 1 PM ET, and traders priced a 99% chance of a Fed rate hike next month on CME FedWatch

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wed Nov 25 (Heat now 10-7), and the Detroit Pistons beat the Orlando Magic 104-86 on Tue Nov 24 (Magic 7-10); the Magic also signed Kevin Porter Jr. on Nov 26; next: Heat at the New York Knicks Fri Nov 27 at 7 PM ET, Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28 at 5 PM ET

NFL Thanksgiving Thu Nov 26 — all three games were decided in the final minute: Chicago Bears 39, Detroit Lions 35; Philadelphia Eagles 39, Dallas Cowboys 38; Buffalo Bills 13, Kansas City Chiefs 10 on a 57-yard field goal as time expired; no Florida team played Thanksgiving — ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
